readerCopy.headline: Confidence is not the same as proof.
readerCopy.body:
A bigger role or plan can feel obvious because you can already picture yourself doing it. Then the schedule, skill, authority, or cost shows you what is still missing. You may also take a delay or a smaller response more personally because you were already living in the larger version in your head.

Jupiter square Sun can make ambition outrun the current setup. Do not play small, but do not make certainty do the work preparation still needs to do. Find the missing piece and build it. A good idea does not become less good because it needs another step.
doNotAssume: Do not assume ego problems, failure, conflict with authority, or that the reader is overestimating every opportunity.
